verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS email platform that ships SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack covers opting out of Mailgun's own telemetry or usage tracking of the account holder. The open/click tracking items are about tracking email recipients for the sender, not about telemetry on the user, so they are not credited here.
